ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-04-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Susan Lee.
Petitioner, Joanne Garman Chan present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true correct and sufficient.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Joanne Carmen Chan.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-24-2004 Reset To Mar-04-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
The Petitioner's Mother, Conni Chan present in court and request a continuance for Petitioner due to illness.
The Court grants continuance to March 4, 2004 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
